-- Mark OP/DAYCARE/EMERGENCY patients from previous business dates as inactive
UPDATE bcp_active_patient
SET is_active = false,
    active_until = NOW()
WHERE is_active = true
  AND care_setting IN ('OUTPATIENT', 'DAYCARE', 'EMERGENCY')
  AND business_date < CURRENT_DATE
  AND tenant_id = '{{ $env.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID }}';

-- Update business_date for still-active inpatients
UPDATE bcp_active_patient
SET business_date = CURRENT_DATE
WHERE is_active = true
  AND care_setting = 'INPATIENT'
  AND business_date < CURRENT_DATE
  AND tenant_id = '{{ $env.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID }}';
